text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So we're settled on this curriculum for this week's practice.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard with your independent training, alright?
Don't push yourself too hard with your independent training, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Well then, I shall go get changed.
I will see you on the grounds shortly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Please, rest on my shoulder...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
......I'm alright.
It just stung a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I need to redo the taping
much tighter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for you to run
even though you're in pain...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, if it's only this much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of my limits.
I wish to avoid any situation that would prevent me
from running in the Japanese Derby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Yaeno-san, please do not worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "I am prepared to risk life and limb for the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if I burn out, I don't care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —No. I want to burn myself out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "If by burning out I can radiate brilliance. If with that radiance, I can etch proof that I lived."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Together with you, Chiyono O-san, and everyone else... I want to run in a supreme race that will shine brilliantly in history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"So please, I beg of you.
Please focus on your own training."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I swear to run in a manner
worthy of your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san... thank you
for granting my request."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby, I must achieve results
like my sister's, no matter what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: When she was young, my dear sister suffered from trouble with her legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yet she overcame that,
and achieved the first Triple Tiara in history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That glory shines ever so blindingly—
radiant as the "Treasure of the Mejiro."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to shine just like my sister.
To shine, and engrave the trajectory of my life into history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to carve your name into history,
then the honor of the "Japanese Derby" is most fitting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I must win.
The Japan Derby, of all races—!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

Yaeno Muteki silently threw herself into training.
A fierce spirit that wasn't present during the meeting earlier
now overflowed from her resolute eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I would like to request one more run.
I felt that my acceleration was still somewhat lacking.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go for one more.
Yeah, let's do one more set.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaahhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, haah, haah, haah,
...ngh, *cough*, *hack*!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
......Phew...... Pheeeww......
...Not yet... not yet...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I can't run through something like this with ease...
I won't be able to win... at 2400m...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Because Maruzen-san's feelings
were entrusted to me...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...More... More, more, more!
Keep going!! Until I break past my limits!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... The Nippon Derby is the one race
I will never give up to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll win for Maruzen-san's sake too!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Even from this distance, Chiyono O-san's
intensity pierces right through to my skin..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Like a wild wolf...
Aiming to rip out my throat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Chiyono O-san's fervent desire to push past her limits
without regard for her own well-being,
all to grasp that crown of glory..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even if it literally costs her own body,
Ardan's resolve to run in the moment and shine...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The once-in-a-lifetime Nippon Derby.
Both of them are pouring every fiber of their being
into that single, fateful moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I cannot yield either.
Even knowing both of your feelings and resolve...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even if I must crush that wish to pieces, victory shall be mine!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To face this with utter sincerity in a true contest is my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono!! Let us have a match, if you please!

Perhaps inspired by Sakura Chiyono O and the others—
Yaeno Muteki's gaze burned with even fiercer passion, bursting with fighting spirit.
